name: Karei Naru Jinsei 2
source:
Karei naru Jinsei 2 is a board/dating simulation game, very similar to its predecessor. As in the first game, players can compete against each other or against computer AI in an adult-themed board game, with the eventual goal of having sex with various female characters.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/karei-naru-jinsei-2]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《Karei naru Jinsei 2》是一款棋盘/约会模拟游戏，与其前身非常相似。与第一款游戏一样，玩家可以在成人主题棋盘游戏中相互竞争或与计算机人工智能竞争，最终目标是与各种女性角色发生性关系。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/karei-naru-jinsei-2]Mobygames[/url]]
